senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; v. חָנַט) [the clean, bright, cmp. פת נקיה, s. v. נָקִי,] wheat-grain, (collect.) wheat.
units: <cite ref="Psalms 2:12">Midr. Till. to Ps. II, 12</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:3:3">Cant. R. to VII, 3</cite> <he>מה ח׳ זו סדוקה</he> as the wheat-grain is slit.
Shebu. V, 3 אמר ח׳ if he says ḥittah (in the sing.).
Ib. 38ᵃ אפי׳ ח׳ בכלל חטין even ḥittah means a quantity of wheat.
Tosef. Ned. III, 7; Y. ib. VI, end, 40ᵃ חי׳ שאני וכ׳ if one vows, ‘I will not taste ḥittah (wheat-grains)’, contrad. to חִטִּין; a. fr.—Pl. חִטִּים, חִטִּין, חִי׳. Ib.
<cite ref="Pesachim 35a:6">Ib. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>כוסמין מין ח׳</he> spelt is a species of wheat; <cite ref="Menachot 70a:17">Men. 70ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15:7">Gen. R. s. 15</cite> <he>ח׳ היו</he> ‘the tree of knowledge’ was wheat. Shebu. l. c.; a. fr.
